name: Azir
title: the Emperor of the Sands

Q.name: Conquering Sands
Q.description: Azir orders all Sand Soldiers to an area, dealing 75/95/115/135/155 + 0.35/0.4/0.45/0.5/0.55×AP magic damage to enemies they pass through and Slowing them by 25% for 1 second.
Q.summary: Azir sends all Sand Soldiers towards a location. Sand Soldiers deal magic damage to enemies they pass through and apply a slow for 1 second.

W.name: Arise!
W.description: Azir summons a Sand Soldier for 10 seconds. When Azir Attacks an enemy near a Sand Soldier, he instead orders the soldiers to stab, dealing 50/65/80/95/110 + None+ (by level) + 0.35/0.425/0.5/0.575/0.65×AP magic damage in their direction. This Ability has (varies) charges.
W.summary: Azir summons a Sand Soldier to attack nearby targets for him, replacing his basic attack against targets within the soldier's range. Their attacks deal magic damage to enemies in a line.

E.name: Shifting Sands
E.description: Azir grants himself 70/110/150/190/230 + 0.6×AP Shield for 1.5 seconds and dashes to one of his Sand Soldiers, dealing 70/110/150/190/230 + 0.6×AP magic damage to enemies he passes through. If Azir hits an enemy champion, he stops and gains a Sand Soldier charge.
E.summary: Azir shields himself briefly and dashes to one of his Sand Soldiers, damaging enemies. If he hits an enemy champion, he instantly readies a new Sand Soldier for deployment and halts his dash.

R.name: Emperor's Divide
R.description: Azir summons a wall of armored soldiers that charges forward, Knocking Back enemies and dealing 200/400/600 + 0.75×AP magic damage. The soldiers remain, blocking enemy paths for 5 seconds.
R.summary: Azir summons a wall of soldiers which charge forward, knocking back and damaging enemies.

Passive.name: Shurima's Legacy
Passive.description: Azir can summon the Disc of the Sun from the ruins of allied or enemy turrets.
Passive.summary: Azir can summon the Disc of the Sun from the ruins of allied or enemy turrets.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Control mage who attacks through Sand Soldiers; scales hard and repositions fights with his E-Q shuffle and R wall.
strengths: High sustained damage through soldiers at range
E-Q (+R) shuffle: knock enemies back into his team
Strong late game and turret pressure
weaknesses: Weak early and mana-heavy; low level 1-2
Gets dived when E is down
profile.curveNote: Farms safely early; trades harder once W rank and R are up.

keyAbilities.trading: W soldier attacks with Q reposition

W.notes: soldier stabs are triggered by his attacks (on-attack)

E.notes: dash to soldier, shield, stops on first champion

profile.windowAgainst: W soldiers out of position or E down: no escape.
checks: Does Jax E dodge soldier stabs? (they're triggered by attacks)
